body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit sideways.
Deal 1 Necrotic Damage on a hit.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: on a hit, bind the target. Trigger: it is forcibly moved by a later Action. Echo: suppress 1 point of its ordinary Fortitude bonuses against the next attack before your next turn.
